decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully captures integration of the book cover with the hero headline.
Changing the book cover's placement does not alter the hero copy attributes; the messaging changes in the same source are independent decisions.
The book-cover placement decision does not change any FAQ content or behavior.
The mechanics, prize, tone, and tagline messaging remains semantically independent of where the book cover is displayed.
Hero book-cover placement does not affect dashboard commission or prize-ticket displays.
The landing-page cover placement does not change the ebook viewer, reading mode, entry points, or download behavior.
Book-cover placement has no logical effect on prize eligibility, randomness, weighting, or winner selection.
The placement of the book cover does not alter the NFT mint number's referral-code identity or display locations.
The visual placement decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat payment flow, wallet provisioning, or mint delivery.
Moving the book cover into the hero does not affect the optional tipping control on the minting page.
The book-cover placement decision does not affect automatic prize transfer, winner announcements, or notifications.
The landing-page book-cover placement has no effect on mint price, revenue shares, or the active prize pool.
